fear-soundscape.js is a local browser bundle of Tone.js 15.1.22 and the Fear Viewer fearful instruments.
Tone.js is MIT licensed; see Tone-LICENSE.md.
The instrument code was adapted from the user-provided fear-viewer/source/soundscapes/engine.js.
Source: scripts/fear-soundscape-entry.js. Rebuild: npm run audio:build-fear.
The original 76 BPM clusters, 4 Hz tremolo, 7.2-second reverb, sub notes, triangle stabs, envelopes and harmony are retained.
The gallery wraps their output in its existing guide-ducked audio bus and supplies a separate filtered moving-wind layer.
